title: Physics GNN Symbolic Discovery: A Self-Auditing Graph Neural Network for Classical Mechanics
claim_boundary: Closed synthetic benchmark: route learning, checkpoint sensitivity, and auditability; no claim of a new physical law.

evidence.flat_mlp: three seeds; validation-selected five-epoch reference; mean L0-L4 R2 values 0.96763, 0.92487, 0.87659, 0.87036, 0.51508
evidence.checkpoint_interventions: one archived checkpoint; inference-time interventions; deterministic 100-example subset per route
evidence.audit: 400 screened pairs; 254 certified monomial consequences; 33 prior-sensitive artifacts
